detail.longDescription:
Hello #homelab and #selfhosted community.

I have been building a control plane to run VMs (not containers) on commodity hardware at scale for about 4 years. I have a few people using it in private beta.

The goals are simple: feature parity with AWS (security groups, VPCs, etc).

Currently: It's easy to deploy, supports cloud-init, #terraform , RBAC, VPCs, Security Groups,  x86 and Arm.

It is built entirely on #Debian , #postgresql  and #qemu .

Is this something you'd use? If so how?
